summary: Max Verstappen won the Las Vegas Grand Prix from pole position, 0.6s ahead of Lando Norris, with Oscar Piastri completing the podium.
Oscar Piastri made the biggest climb, from P17 to P3.
Isack Hadjar had a day to forget, dropping from P4 to P15.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
The stewards penalised HAM (10 second time penalty) and LEC (10 second time penalty).
There were 23 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 98 points over Max Verstappen.
aiSummary: Max Verstappen converted pole into victory on a chilly, dry night in Las Vegas, holding off Lando Norris by just 0.639s. The standout drive belonged to Oscar Piastri, who stormed from 17th on the grid to complete the podium. A safety car between laps 19 and 25 bunched the field, and the racing proved relentless, with 239 on-track overtakes. Lewis Hamilton made 19 of them on his way to seventh despite a ten-second penalty, matched by one for Charles Leclerc. George Russell slipped from second to ninth, and Isack Hadjar tumbled from fourth to 15th. Kimi Antonelli's fourth place keeps him 98 points clear of Verstappen.
